articles.title: Bitcoin rally sparks debate whether Clarity Act is already priced in
articles.snippet: Erald Ghoos, OKX Europe CEO, says U.S. crypto rules could blow new life into the market amid a rotation of capital from AI back to bitcoin.

articles.title: Trader who made $49 million shorting crypto lost $24 million on ether in 12 seconds
articles.snippet: The Hyperliquid wallet known as pension-usdt.eth was forced out of a 50,000 ETH short as ether surged, with five liquidation orders helping push the price higher during the unwind.

articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: Where DeFi yield really comes from (and why it broke this spring)
articles.snippet: In this week's Crypto Long & Short, Solstice Finance's David Plisek argues that most of the money lost in DeFi this spring wasn't taken by hackers but by yield strategies that quietly stopped working. Looking at April's $13 billion drawdown, he shows that a headline yield number reveals almost nothing about whether it will hold under stress, laying out four questions an allocator should ask before committing capital.

articles.title: HSBC, Standard Chartered execute first live banking transaction on Swift’s 24/7 ledger
articles.snippet: The cross-border transaction is Swift’s first in a pilot project as it tests settlement in its push to remain relevant as stablecoins and tokenized deposits become widely used worldwide.

articles.title: Bitcoin miners pour billions into AI as capex outpaces revenue 15-to-1
articles.snippet: Nine public miners generated $341 million from AI and HPC operations in the first half of 2026 after spending more than $5 billion on capital assets.
